Themes: a language model small enough to see
PresentationContext.VisualContinuity: Every graphic in the series is a CoCo screen: black on green, amber for the one thing that changed, navy for emphasis, uppercase blocky type.

Style.Rendering: Flat, pixel-precise illustration as if drawn by an MC6847 video chip: a 32-by-16 text grid of blocky 8-by-12 pixel glyphs, hard edges, no anti-aliasing, no gradients, no painterly texture. A faint CRT curvature and phosphor glow are allowed at the edges only.

Lighting.Shadows: None; the only dark areas are black ink on the field

Accents: Amber #FAE53D for the one thing that changed
Bar green #8EFF48 for inverse-video text on black
ColorPalette.Treatment: Black on green as the body. Amber marks the single element the viewer should look at; navy marks arrows and labels of emphasis; nothing else is coloured. Never red on green.

Effects: Slight CRT barrel curvature at the frame edges
Soft phosphor bloom around bright areas
Atmosphere.Mood: Plain, exact, a machine showing its work

ContentDescription: Two tall tables side by side on a green CoCo screen, each a column of blank cells with a narrow label cell at the left, like two lookup tables. One row in the left table and one row in the right table are filled amber. Beneath them, the two amber rows are shown again, one above the other, with a navy plus sign and a bar, and a single row of three black cells under the bar as their sum. No readable words or numbers anywhere; every cell is blank.
CompositionNotes: Uppercase blocky type only if any appears; prefer none. Amber marks exactly two rows and nothing else. Navy is used only for the plus sign and the bar. Everything else is black on green. Any words on screen are either supplied by a reference image or absent. The generator must not invent words, numbers or labels; where a label is needed and no reference supplies it, ask for a blank cell instead.

Situation.Name: Two tables, one row fetched from each
Situation.Camera: Straight on, the whole screen in frame

Conceptual.Name: A real CoCo screen
Conceptual.Description: The emulator's own raster from a recorded run: the exact green, the black border, the 32-by-16 grid of blocky uppercase glyphs. Match this look exactly.
Conceptual.Application: Style reference for the whole image

Conceptual.Name: Two lookup tables
Conceptual.Description: Two columns of rectangular cells, about a dozen rows each, one row per table filled amber
Conceptual.Application: Upper two thirds of the screen

Conceptual.Name: The sum
Conceptual.Description: The two amber rows restated and added into one row of three black cells
